summary: Iteration 36 — All 4 backend features (F1 docs admin-only, F2 multi-grant ordinals, F3 enriched /me/awards & /members/{id}/awards, F4 personnel-brief awards_grouped + PDF) and all 3 verified frontend surfaces (F1 Documents page, F5 Profile Awards grouped grid, F6 Admin floating Personnel Brief §8) PASS. 10/10 pytest cases green. Live UI checks: member sees 0 admin-only buttons on /documents (upload-doc-btn=False, new-folder-btn=False); admin sees both. Profile awards tab shows 1 card (distinct count) for member who has 3 grants of 'Life Membership Ribbon' — badge reads '3rd Award · × 3', Awards stat=1, tab label='Awards (1)'. Admin → Reports → Personnel Brief → Riley Chen → §8 renders 'Life Membership Ribbon | 3rd Award (× 3) | 2026-06-05' (one row per distinct award, Latest Date header). PDF returns application/pdf, %PDF magic verified, ~4.8KB (real 2-page PDF; spec said >5KB but observed is 4802 — see note).

minor.issue: Spec asserts size > 5KB; observed PDF for the test member is 4802 bytes. Content is valid (%PDF-1.4, 2 pages, awards_grouped data present in source JSON). Threshold likely needs to be relaxed to >4KB, or padding/branding added. Not a functional bug — flagged for verification.

action_items: (optional) Either relax the >5KB PDF assertion in any future test scaffolding to >4KB, or pad the PDF (e.g., embed AOP letterhead/footer image) so it consistently exceeds 5KB. The PDF itself is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: F1 correctly migrated POST /documents and POST /documents/bulk to admin_tab_dep('documents') — auth dep runs before form parsing, so members get 403 even without a multipart body (verified). Good defense-in-depth.

F2 grant_award correctly computes ordinal = prior_count + 1 and never 400s on duplicate (award_id, user_id). 3 sequential grants returned ordinals 1, 2, 3. ensure_indexes drops the legacy unique compound index on startup — backend boot logs clean (no IndexAlreadyExists / unique violation errors).

F3 /me/awards and /members/{id}/awards rows now carry both `ordinal` AND `award_count` (same value across all rows of the same award). Sort is newest-granted_at first — verified. Backfill works for older grants without an ordinal field.
F4 awards_grouped shape verified: each entry has {award_name, count, last_granted_at, first_granted_at, grants[]}. awards_distinct_count <= awards_count.  PDF header now 'Latest Date'.

F5 Profile.jsx Awards tab groups by `award_id || award_name` client-side from the flat /me/awards response. Stat card and tab label both use the distinct Set count (verified live: 1 card for 3 grants, badge '3rd Award · × 3').
F6 Reports.jsx admin floating brief §8 uses awardsGrouped if present, falls back to local grouping — verified live: 'Life Membership Ribbon | 3rd Award (× 3) | 2026-06-05'.

Note for next iteration: Awards page (/awards) is still flat-list (out of scope this iteration per main agent note). When it gets updated, reuse the same grouping helper from Profile.jsx to keep behavior consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (F1 member+admin, F5 profile grouped card+badge, F6 admin brief grouped row — all verified live)
